# noust_team_variable (Resource)

A team's shared variable, defined once and used by reference from an application's own variables (`DATABASE_URL={{team.DATABASE_URL}}`). It is never injected by itself: an application gets only what it names. Removing one is allowed while applications refer to it, and the provider warns with their names, because their next deploy fails until the reference changes.

Needs the permission `apps.manage` and sudo mode to change or remove one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Defined once for a team, used by reference from an application's own variables:
# DATABASE_URL = "{{team.DATABASE_URL}}". A name that looks like a credential is masked in every read;
# `secret` says it outright.
resource "noust_team_variable" "registry_token" {
  team   = noust_team.acme.slug
  name   = "REGISTRY_TOKEN"
  value  = var.registry_token
  secret = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The variable's name: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits and underscores. A reference spells it `{{team.NAME}}`. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `team` (String) The slug of the team. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Its value; references to other scopes such as `{{server.REGION}}` are allowed. A secret's value is masked in every read of the API, so the state keeps the one the configuration wrote and a change made by hand to a secret is not seen; a value that is not a secret is compared like any attribute.

### Optional

- `audience` (String) Which part of a deployment an application that uses it hands it to: `both`, `build` or `runtime`. Default `both`.
- `secret` (Boolean) `true` to mark the variable a secret (masked in every read and log), `false` to say it is not, unset to let the server decide from its name and value (`PASSWORD`, `TOKEN` and the shapes of known credentials are secrets).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The variable's place in the state: `team/NAME`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The team's slug, then the variable's name. A secret's value is not in any read: the next plan sets the
# value in the configuration.
terraform import noust_team_variable.registry_token acme/REGISTRY_TOKEN
```
